description: This Java source file defines the NoteEditor activity for an Android note-taking application. It handles creating, editing, viewing, copying, pasting, and deleting notes, including a custom LinedEditText view for drawing lines between text lines.

classes.name: NoteEditor
classes.description: An Activity for editing, creating, viewing, and managing notes, including clipboard paste handling and custom drawing of line borders.

classes.name: LinedEditText
classes.description: A custom EditText view that draws lines between each line of text for visual clarity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the editing state, and loads the note data.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the state of the activity, particularly the original content for reverting if needed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Lifecycle method; overridden but only calls super.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Saves or deletes the note depending on the current state when the activity stops.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for saving, deleting, and reverting notes; adds alternative actions.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items depending on whether the note has changed.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user actions from the options menu, such as save, delete, and revert.

methods.name: performPaste
methods.description: Handles pasting note content from the clipboard, supporting both note URIs and plain text.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates or inserts a note with the provided text and title.

methods.name: cancelNote
methods.description: Reverts changes or deletes new notes when canceled.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader for asynchronous note data retrieval.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Populates the UI with loaded note data and updates the activity title.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Handles cleanup when loader is reset; empty implementation here.
